Brandon tells a joke about insuring taste buds for a million dollars. Benjamin finds it fascinating. Brandon connects it to risk assessment. Benjamin says their business is less unusual but equally important.
- Follow-up support: Pleased by Benjamin’s positive response to his anecdotes, Brandon offers additional advice: strategic investments and security upgrades could lower premiums. Benjamin says he is all ears, calls Brandon’s insights invaluable, says he had not thought of it, calls it smart/win-win, and wants to explore it further.
- Joint venture proposal: Encouraged by their rapport and mutual benefits, Brandon proposes co-developing a platform that integrates risk management with financial planning for entrepreneurs.
